Police report KY-26-104223 received. Detective is checking the partial plate.

If the other driver is identified, the claim moves to their liability insurer and the $250 deductible is refunded.

Mobile replacement scheduled with Clearview Auto Glass at the policyholder's workplace.
Windshield replaced and camera recalibrated. $1,240 paid directly to Clearview Auto Glass.
Claim closed.

CLM-2026-527613.description: The policyholder was northbound on Preston Highway when a Nissan Altima entered the intersection from Outer Loop and struck the driver's side of the insured Kia. The impact pushed the Kia into a third vehicle waiting to turn left. Both drivers say they had a green light. One witness gave a statement. The policyholder reported neck pain the next day.

financials.label: Estimated insurance payment
financials.value: $11,400, on hold until liability is decided

financials.label: Medical payments
financials.value: $640 urgent care bill submitted, under review

notes.text: Claim reported from the scene. Vehicle towed to Southside Collision Center.
Rental authorized at $40 per day; the 30-day limit ended 2026-10-31 and $1,200 was paid.
Witness statement collected. Witness believes the Altima ran a red light.
Traffic camera footage requested from Louisville Metro.
Riverbend Auto Insurance disputes liability pending the footage.
Policyholder may repair now under collision coverage, paying the $500 deductible, and Tri-County will seek it back if Riverbend is found at fault.
